# Shaping

## What it means

Shaping is the [pillar](./pillar.md) of the Human Lead deciding how the Space works, by writing and changing the [Lore](./lore.md). Specifying, Planning, Working and Producing are all governed by files in the Lore, and Shaping is the Human Lead writing those files. Everything that a session reads about how to behave is markdown that the Human Lead can read, change and keep in git. There is no setting in another place and no code to change.

What can be changed and what cannot is the subject of the [layers](./layer.md): the core cannot be changed, the defaults can be replaced, and the Human Lead can add whatever the Space needs beyond the defaults.

## Where it is kept

Shaping changes the files under `lore/`. The Space's own files are beside the `core/` and `default/` folders of each part.

## What acts on it

No process ships for Shaping, because the Lore is changed one verb at a time. The five authoring verbs serve this pillar: verb-add, process-add, contract-add, corpus-add and payload-add. They are core. Each needs the session in Writing with the Lore as its write target. The core contract lore-integrity guards this pillar.
